description: Every loaded year of the regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one kabupaten/kota, oldest first, each row with its source instrument and URL: a governor decree, or for some regions the open-data portal of the regional government (source_instrument then starts with Portal and notes that the dataset has no decree number). Covers Jawa Barat 2023 to 2026, Jawa Tengah 2022 to 2026, Jawa Timur 2024 to 2026, a few Riau and Bali regions for 2024, Kalimantan Barat (2019, 2022, 2025), Banten (2020 to 2024), seven Sumatera Selatan regions (2024), five Kalimantan Timur regions (Berau, Kutai Barat, Kutai Timur, Penajam Paser Utara, Samarinda), six Magelang-area regions 2014 to 2020, Kota Tegal 2021 and Rembang (2010, 2019).
name: get_umk_history
